scope_and_limitations: This review consumed existing READY/FREEZE_RECEIPT plus locally mirrored source/evidence/dependency metadata; no freeze, module/Torch/model/tensor/QA/GPU/asset hash/scoring/bootstrap was executed.

Package location records are internally consistent metadata, not evidence of successful BF16 execution, native EOS generation, actual live storage counts or quality.
The reported 0.2147349049919285 seconds belongs to the existing metadata freeze receipt, not a duration independently measured by this reviewer.

This admits a fixed descriptive starting baseline only; it does not reopen failed E/Q/R implementations or prove RW/RS, expert redundancy, model capability, new method novelty or the research goal achieved.
Explored DEV scores cannot become a positive-retain/negative-discard model search or per-question route/module selection rule.
